evidence: General external-boundary obstruction and mandatory absorption are Lean checked. Two singleton instances consume these laws and connect to existing larger-region repairs with whole-graph reconstruction. The full finite census and spherical geometry are program evidence.
scope: An odd external boundary forbids keeping the proposed region fixed under every proper four-colouring, hence under arbitrary preparation histories. This is not an impossibility theorem for adaptive regions or compositional Four Colour proofs.
Every closed enlargement must absorb at least one vertex of each obstructing odd walk. The theorem supplies a necessary condition, not compatible choices, a bound on growth or termination.
Both successful histories already existed. The new consumer shows why each uses a strictly larger region than either obstructed singleton; it is not a newly discovered repair.
The 75 bipartite-boundary cases that fail one transverse switch have no arbitrary-history obstruction established by this work.
No new configuration reduction, source catalogue removal or kernel saving is claimed.
